subject.why: It is clearly a giant twisting beanstalk with large leaves and the requested golden beans hanging below them.

category.why: Category 4 requires visible sky above the object and a clear ground strip at the bottom, but the beanstalk pierces the top edge and rests on a floating dirt chunk rather than a continuous strip.

clean.why: There are no characters, text, UI elements, or borders.

framing.why: The top of the beanstalk is cut off by the upper edge of the frame instead of having a clear margin.

colour.why: The palette is saturated, warm, and bright, with strong contrast between the green stalk and the blue sky.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and chunky with no noisy micro-textures or busy clutter.

style.why: Rendered with smooth, semi-glossy chunky 3D volumes consistent with the reference cards.

fix: Scale down the beanstalk so its top fits within the frame with sky above it, and extend the ground into a continuous strip spanning the entire bottom edge.
